# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 05, Series of 2017

**Declaring January 24-25 as Non-Working Holiday (San Pablo Apostol Fiesta — Patron Saint of Pitogo)**

Kapasiyahan Blg. 099

## Summary

Declares **January 24 and 25** of every year as non-working holidays in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] in observance of the town fiesta honoring [[San Pablo Apostol]] (Saint Paul the Apostle), the patron saint of Pitogo. During these dates, schools and government offices are closed.

Absent during session: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Non-Working Holiday:** January 24-25 declared as non-working holidays in Pitogo
- **Occasion:** Annual fiesta of Pitogo honoring San Pablo Apostol (St. Paul the Apostle who converted to the Lord)
- **Effect:** Schools and government offices closed during the fiesta days
- **Scope:** Applies to all government offices and educational institutions within the municipality

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
